module: Flowgraph node "Race Highscores" (category repeat_instant, tag scenario), "lap" variant. Identical to raceHighscoresComplete but records under the identifier missionTypeData.trackName (without the "mission-" prefix). Writes the time of the vehicle's last pass in core_highscores.setScenarioHighscoresCustom then stores {place, scores} in state.raceComepleteHighscores. Inputs: flow, raceData, vehId; output: flow.
notes: Runs every frame as long as flow is active (print "Writing Highscores..." and repeated writing): give it flow only once.
The old pin 'clear' is redirected to 'reset' (legacyPins), but no reset pin is declared in the pinSchema of this file.

init.desc: Initializes self.markers to nil (not used afterwards).

work.desc: Copies flow and records the vehicle's highscore, then stores the result in its state.
